update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.13 - Parent farming reliability
Fixes --- - Smart Race Solver fuzzy-matches on-screen race names when OCR differs from the plan - Parent farming falls back to fan racing when smart race selection fails - Forced-epithet fail-fast enabled by default; minimum race gap 1 in base preset - In-app updater rejects bad HTTP responses instead of installing failed downloads
Includes v5.9.12 friend support borrow fix and v5.9.11 game data auto-update.
